claims.explanation: Buphenine is a beta-adrenergic agonist whose selectivity is most plausibly driven by ADRB2 expression: lines with high ADRB2 (and downstream cAMP/PKA signaling) are sensitized, while low-ADRB2 lines are protected. The pattern of sensitive lines is enriched for RAS/RTK-MAPK pathway activation (KRAS, NRAS, HRAS, BRAF, EGFR, ERBB2, MAP2K1) and PIK3CA/PTEN alterations, suggesting that oncogenic MAPK/PI3K signaling cooperates with beta-adrenergic signaling to drive selective killing. TP53 mutation is nearly universal among sensitive lines but also common in resistant lines, so it is a weak, non-specific feature.

BRAF-mutant melanoma line SH4 is among most sensitive
EGFR-mutant NSCLC line HCC4006 is sensitive
ERBB2-mutant colorectal line SW480 is sensitive
MAP2K1-mutant NSCLC line NCIH1437 is sensitive
PIK3CA-mutant lines (T47D, LU99, MKN1, GP2D, HCC1954) are enriched among sensitive lines
PTEN loss occurs in several sensitive lines (SF295, GP2D, NCIH1339, H4)
HRAS-mutant bladder line T24 is sensitive
TP53 mutation is nearly universal in sensitive lines but also common in resistant lines, so weak
SMARCA4-mutant lines (NCIH1339 sensitive but COV434, NCIH1793, KYSE270 resistant) show mixed pattern; weak
